g.text: One pan support that travels with the renewable body
UNSELECTED. Existing stepped profile retained; walking support is separate from the ordinary air retainer.
Moving pan: apron 0 / crest +15; thickness 1.5 mm.
Two 3 mm formed channels, nominal 26 mm wide; same moving body.
Fixed mineral bearing: proposed top −46.5 on actual common RC −180; added 30 mm south of owning seat.
Channels ≈10.68 kg before bends/welds/retention; no physical/material pass.
Original horizontal draw: stationary +13.5 support blocks the moving 0..15 riser.
Travelling supports avoid that collision; actual bearing/capture and end release still need proof.
End closure, actual support/contact, web/weld, air, water/capillary, thermal and first-release duties stay open.
